description: This file manages execution approval requests, including registration, waiting for decisions, and building request parameters for host and agent contexts within an approval workflow.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalRequestToolParams
methods.description: Constructs parameters for execution approval request, including timeout and two-phase flag.

methods.name: parseDecision
methods.description: Parses a decision object to determine if a decision is present and extract its value.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Trims and validates a string value.

methods.name: parseExpiresAtMs
methods.description: Validates and returns a number representing expiration time in milliseconds.

methods.name: registerExecApprovalRequest
methods.description: Registers an execution approval request with the gateway, returning registration info including decision and expiration.

methods.name: waitForExecApprovalDecision
methods.description: Waits for a decision on an approval request by ID, handling expiration or not found errors.

methods.name: resolveRegisteredExecApprovalDecision
methods.description: Resolves an approval decision, either pre-resolved or by waiting for the registered approval.

methods.name: requestExecApprovalDecision
methods.description: Requests an approval decision, registering if necessary, and returning the final decision.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalRequesterContext
methods.description: Builds context object with agentId and sessionKey for approval requests.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalTurnSourceContext
methods.description: Builds context object with turn source information for approval requests.

methods.name: buildHostApprovalDecisionParams
methods.description: Constructs approval request parameters specific to host context.

methods.name: requestExecApprovalDecisionForHost
methods.description: Requests an approval decision for a host, returning the decision or null.

methods.name: registerExecApprovalRequestForHost
methods.description: Registers an approval request for a host.

methods.name: registerExecApprovalRequestForHostOrThrow
methods.description: Registers an approval request for a host, throwing an error if registration fails.
